title: Exact Differential Form Line Integral
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate int_C (y dx + x dy) along any path from (1, 1) to (3, 5).

steps.title: Recognize Exact Differential of a Product
steps.explanation: By the product rule of differentials, y dx + x dy is the total differential of f(x, y) = xy.

steps.title: Evaluate at Path Endpoints
steps.explanation: Subtract initial value from terminal value.
